def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Strip whitespace from island (label variants)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas from text numbers)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g: values like 3800000 are in mg, convert to g
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Drop any body_mass_g still out of valid range
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: v for k, v in result.items()}
